scenario.name: r-cw-1-tool-schedule-wake
scenario.description: Typed continue_work() tool-form schedule + wake. Fires continue_work with a reason, observes the scheduled work entry and wake event on the session.

invocation.reason: k6-proof-R-CW-1-{{nonce}} -- on continuation wake reply exactly CW-WOKE {{nonce}}

expectedReceipts.name: tool-invoke-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the continue_work tool invocation

expectedReceipts.name: continue-work-tool-result-scheduled
expectedReceipts.description: Post-dispatch non-harness event includes explicit CW-SCHEDULED sentinel emitted after continue_work tool result reports scheduled

expectedReceipts.name: work-woke-event
expectedReceipts.description: Session wake event delivered after delaySeconds

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Unique safe-fingerprint correlation to a public-safe Tempo projection containing same-trace continue_work tool, continuation.work, and continuation.work.fire spans

review.notes: Tool-form continue_work. PASS-candidate requires dispatch accepted + observable scheduled tool result + wake event. Detector must ignore [k6-proof-harness] prompt echoes; do not require an event name that the seat does not emit.

census.limits: Only 8 continuation.work entry spans were accepted fleet-wide in 24h (182 in 7d). This row’s trace receipt joins the continue_work tool span to continuation.work and continuation.work.fire by shared trace, which is the only join available: the entry span carries no origin, session, turn, or run identity, and there is no proof marker separating this row’s fire from an organic one.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and already asserted by the row’s trace-correlation resolver. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: The wake reason is published as a digest and a length. The raw reason, the wake sentinel instruction body, raw session keys, and tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: The dispatch is accepted, the agent emits the scheduled sentinel only after the continue_work tool result reports scheduled, and the wake sentinel arrives after the declared delay.
controls.negative: Harness prompt echoes must not satisfy either sentinel, and an event name the seat does not emit must not be required.
controls.notes: Deploy-persistence, the second half of this row’s historical scope, has no telemetry expression at all and rests on chain-counter observation.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded Tempo makes the trace receipt unavailable. That is receipt debt, not evidence that no wake occurred.

verdictAuthority.pass: Dispatch accepted, observable scheduled tool result, wake event, and a trace receipt. Behavioral only.
verdictAuthority.partial: The trace receipt is missing or the backend is degraded or partial; a disposable-session run that stops at scheduled-only is PARTIAL, never PASS.
verdictAuthority.fail: The scheduled sentinel appears without a wake, or the wake fires without an accepted schedule.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cw-1-tool-schedule-wake.js embeds the wake sentinel instruction in the continue_work reason so the wake turn can be recognised.
execution.manual: Per-seat cross-walk fires remain manual and file under the row’s canonical path.
execution.relationship: Deterministic k6 is the verdict authority; manual cross-walks add seat coverage only.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live continue_work schedule + wake row. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true for repeatability. Serialize per session (sameSessionConcurrencySafe=false). Ignore harness prompt echo; PASS requires explicit CW-SCHEDULED and CW-WOKE sentinels; the scenario embeds the CW-WOKE instruction in the continue_work reason so the wake turn has the required sentinel instruction.
